title: Project Audit Candidates
description: Specialist findings for project audits, including optional Security and Performance & Delivery. Confidence and impact are independent.

lens.description: Lens identifier; matches the artifact filename stem.

candidates.description: Each pattern this lens will stand behind at strength 50 or above. Empty when there are none. At most 8.

title.description: The pattern, twelve words or fewer, naming the wrong thing and the right thing.

problem.description: What a user or a maintainer experiences because of this pattern, effect first. Two to four sentences. Never empty.

fix.description: Concrete proposed remedy with its behavioral result and affected interface.

wins.description: Short bullets, six words or fewer each, on what improves once the fix lands.

effort.description: S: mechanical edits at every instance in one sitting. M: edits plus a small local change per instance. L: needs a new shared piece or a design decision first.

strength.description: Confidence: 100 mechanically established, 75 supported by quoted evidence and a grounded remedy, 50 uncertain. Patterns require three instances. Traces require all path roles, two distinct locations, a sourced invariant, a scenario, and verification. Agreement never promotes confidence.

instances.description: Quoted evidence locations. Trace steps also count as instances during merge. Repetition is required only for pattern findings.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

line.description: The line the quote sits on. A wrong line is worse than no instance.

quote.description: Verbatim source fragment with sensitive values replaced by [REDACTED] before writing any artifact; retain surrounding code and file:line.

before.description: A short representative snippet as it is today. Optional.

after.description: The same snippet after the fix. Optional.

tokens.description: For design-system drift: each raw value found, the token that should replace it, the token's value, and where the token is defined. A token without a source does not count toward the source gate.

source.description: file:line where the token or component is defined.

convention_source.description: file:line of the spot in this repo that already does it right. Required for a design-system candidate at 75 or 100 that names no sourced token.

prior_decision.description: Source document for an accepted tradeoff, a violated decision, or a decision proposed for review. Set decision_status explicitly.

category.description: Report category, independent of the contributing specialist.

evidence_kind.description: pattern is repeated drift; trace is a proven boundary or flow defect.

impact.description: Consequence supported by the problem and scenario; does not express confidence.

reach.description: Extent of the affected behavior, supported by the traced callers.

evidence_status.description: Use static for source inspection. Runtime requires an existing executed evidence reference.

decision_status.description: accepted is dismissed; violated is an implementation defect; revisit needs a decision before implementation.

action.description: Traces and large changes always become plans; revisited decisions always need a decision.

remediation.description: Ordered migration and verification steps for a structural plan.

root_cause.description: Specific underlying cause used for deduplication.

affected_boundary.description: Named interface or boundary; matching code locations alone do not imply matching causes.

invariant.description: The required property violated by a trace.

invariant_source.description: Document, contract, or code location establishing the invariant. Security requires file:line and the invariant quoted from that location in scope.

scenario.description: Concrete trigger, traced behavior and resulting consequence; distinguish observation from inference.

verification.description: Proposed behavioral or measurement acceptance check, with bounded inputs and an observable pass condition. Never claim it ran here.

decision_reason.description: Changed assumptions or evidence requiring an accepted decision to be reconsidered.

compatibility.description: Compatibility constraints and consumers affected by the proposed migration.

rollback.description: How to reverse the migration or why a reversal is unavailable.

runtime_evidence.description: Path and result of an executed check; never a proposed test.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

line.description: The line the quote sits on. A wrong line is worse than no instance.

quote.description: Verbatim source fragment with sensitive values replaced by [REDACTED] before writing any artifact; retain surrounding code and file:line.

role.description: Role in the trace. One location may serve two roles; at least two distinct locations are needed overall.

trace.description: Ordered trace with quoted source, boundary and consumer steps. All roles required for a strong trace.

flow.description: Explain how the quoted source reaches the boundary and consumer, including enclosing controls and unresolved links.

assessment.description: Demonstrated means the stated code invariant violation is established; it does not imply exploitation or production exposure. Inferred risks remain weak.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

line.description: The line the quote sits on. A wrong line is worse than no instance.

quote.description: Verbatim source fragment with sensitive values replaced by [REDACTED] before writing any artifact; retain surrounding code and file:line.

control_review.description: Quoted enclosing middleware, policy or framework registration inspected before asserting a missing control.

cost_assessment.description: Performance only: source-derived avoidable work or an existing attributable measured bottleneck. Static proof never establishes runtime cost.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

line.description: The line the quote sits on. A wrong line is worse than no instance.

quote.description: Verbatim source fragment with sensitive values replaced by [REDACTED] before writing any artifact; retain surrounding code and file:line.

measurement.description: Existing executed result, quoted at its location, and attribution to the traced costly boundary. No proposed checks or fabricated metrics.

residual_risks.description: Concerns you could not raise to a candidate, including limits of your own search.

coverage.description: What you read and what you skipped, so the report can say what the audit did not see.

notes.description: Record traced flows, unexamined boundaries, static-only limits, and the search scope of absence claims.

status.description: complete only when the selected scope and important flows were examined; record limits and skipped source as partial. This is coverage, not a correctness certification.

unavailable_controls.description: External or inaccessible security controls that remain unexamined. Nonempty means partial coverage.

unavailable_scope.description: Inaccessible configuration, execution paths or external deployment steps. Forces partial examined coverage.
